cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Just Say Yes
cards.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Quick yes to the garden party before the booking expires? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Let's secure the date, then count chairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fetch the quote while you say yes. That way we won't lose the booking while you're reading it.
